warning: Red: WRD-designated waterfowl refuges. Amber: WMAs whose 2026–27 listing limits waterfowl hunting (days, noon closing, quota hunts, designated ponds) and lakes with distance rules from docks, houses and ramps. Ponds closed inside a WMA (for example MARSH ponds) are named in that WMA’s amber text, not drawn. Federal refuges set their own rules (Refuges layer).
source: Georgia WRD 2026–27 regulations: Migratory Birds Seasons (special lake regulations) and WMA listings A–Z; WRD WMA designated areas (waterfowl refuges).
